name: Marie Bouzková
intro: Marie Bouzková is from Prague, in Czechia. She is a super-fast runner who chases down everything. Even the WTA Tour calls her defense astounding.
story: Marie started at a tennis club her parents owned in Prague. At 16 she won the US Open junior title, right here in New York. Now she lives in Florida and plays on the big tour. This year she won a title on grass and reached her best ranking ever.

funFacts.text: She speaks four languages: Czech, English, German, and Spanish.
She follows lots of mountain dog accounts online. She wants one after she retires.
She listens to Mozart before matches to calm her mind.
Her favorite emoji on grass courts is the strawberry.
She finished a college business degree while playing on tour.
She won the US Open girls' title in 2014, at age 16.
She loves drawing, reading, and playing Wordle in her free time.

watchFor: Watch her chase down shot after shot in long rallies. Her defense is so good the WTA called it astounding.
